Operates in the **Agriculture** sector in Kuala Lumpur, focusing on oil‑palm plantation and fresh fruit bunch supply. Share capital is **RM250.0k**.  

**Director & Shareholder:** The company has **4 directors** and **3 shareholders**. The largest shareholder is **Director 3** with **58.92 %** of the equity.  

**Financials:** The latest audited figures are for FY 2024. No prior year data is available, so year‑on‑year revenue growth cannot be computed. Revenue was **RM74.30m**, gross profit **RM15.66m**, giving a **gross profit margin of 21.1 %**; operating profit was a loss of **RM2.53m**, yielding an **operating profit margin of –3.4 %**. Free cash flow was **RM‑6.64m**, indicating negative cash generation, and net debt (borrowings – cash) stood at **RM9.81m**.  

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.  

**Review Rating:** **2/5 – Low review priority**. The firm shows negative operating margin and free‑cash‑flow loss with modest net debt, despite an active status and no litigation.
